parts:
Hi everybody, 

I write you because I can't open JGR on my Windows 7 machine, a few months ago I download R-project and Deducer and all was ok, but I had a problem with other program and after to restore my machine, I can't open JGR again. I eliminated the programs and download it again since http://www.r-project.org/ and 
http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.DeducerManual?from=Main.HomePage

I send you a document with the message that come up from the R console.

I know that is a vague idea, but I hope that you can help me. 

Thank you so much.

messages.subject: Re: Deducer error
parts:
You can try two things:

1. just double click on jgr-1_62.exe to launch. The options should
mostly take care of themselves.
2. put quotes around the libpath command line arguments to take care
of the fact that your paths have spaces

This list is about Deducer, for JGR related queries use:
stats-ros...@listserv.uni-augsburg.de

best,
ian
